description.text: The International Preparatory Program is a non-academic pre-school preparatory education program for international students set up by the College of Lifelong Education of Shanghai Jiao Tong University. The Foundation program is tailored to the characteristics of international students. International students can improve their language, professional and cross-cultural communication skills according to their needs, and lay a solid foundation for future university studies. International preparatory students who pass the official assessment can be prefered to study at Shanghai Jiao Tong University. International Preparatory Students Program includes: Project A enrollment target is international students who have a good Chinese language foundation (HSK 4≧180 or equivalent Chinese language level) and need to further improve their Chinese, English, mathematics and other subjects. Project B provides Chinese language training for international students with no or weak Chinese language foundation but good performance in other subjects, and also helps students improve their academic ability in mathematics, English and other aspects. For international students who have a certain English foundation and need to further improve their English, mathematics and other subjects, this program is taught in English. The above three types of projects are set up according to the needs of science, agriculture, medicine and humanities and social sciences two major directions. The department of Science, Agriculture and Medicine corresponds to the majors of shipbuilding and ocean engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science and technology, software engineering, materials science and Engineering, aerospace engineering, environmental science and engineering, Chemical Engineering and technology, statistics, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, pharmacy, Clinical medicine, Stomatology, etc. Humanities and Social Sciences correspond to finance, economics, business administration, accounting, communication, radio and television production, visual communication design, language and other majors.

materials.text: The applicant shall ensure that the application materials and information provided are true, accurate and complete. If it is found to be untrue, the applicant will be disqualified from applying for admission or studying. High school diploma or equivalent. Fresh graduates can first provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their high school.High school profile, in Chinese or English (such as the overall situation of the school, admission requirements, admission, curriculum system, high school score scoring system, admission status, etc.).Passport information page (valid for more than 6 months) and personal identification photo (color, crown free).Self-statement letter, in Chinese or English (signed by myself, including but not limited to personal background, hobbies and strengths, reasons for application and study plan, 600-1000 words).One recommendation letter, in Chinese or English (the referrer needs to sign and provide contact information such as email and phone number). 6. Proof of academic level: 6.1 Transcript issued by your high school (including all courses in high school).2 Unify high school graduation examination or college entrance examination scores, such as SAT/ACT/IB/ A-Level/UEC, etc. in your country or region. If the above test results or other results recognized by the program are not available, information must be provided.Proof of Language proficiency Students applying for Project A are required to provide HSK score (HSK Level 4 ≥180) or equivalent qualification. Students applying for Program C are required to provide a TOEFL score (total score ≥80) or an IELTS score (total score ≥5.5) or equivalent qualification.Applicant's birth certificate.Nationality or household registration certificate of both parents (passport or ID card).If both parents or one parent is a Chinese citizen, the following supporting materials shall be provided: 10.1 Proof that the applicant acquired foreign nationality at birth or later acquired foreign nationality. 10.2 If the applicant acquired foreign nationality at birth, ① if both parents or one parent is a Chinese citizen and has permanent residence abroad, the corresponding permanent residence certificate of the parents shall be provided; (2) If both parents or one parent is a Chinese citizen but has not obtained permanent residence abroad, the applicant shall provide a certificate of renunciation of Chinese nationality. 10.3 If the applicant is a Chinese citizen and acquires a foreign nationality after being a Chinese citizen, he/she shall provide a certificate of cancellation of the original Chinese household registration and a certificate of renunciation of Chinese nationality. 10.4 Signature page of the applicant's passport entering and leaving China from April 30, 2020 (inclusive) to the time of application.Applicants under the age of 18 as of September 1, 2024 shall provide a guardian guarantee certificate in China (a notarized document recognized by our school is required).Award certificate (if any) and other supporting materialsOther materials that need to be described. Note: ① If the above application materials are not in Chinese or English, notarized Chinese or English translation must be provided. There is no need to mail paper application materials at the application stage.

requirements.text: High school graduate or equivalent.Non-chinese citizens who hold a valid foreign passport and comply with the Ministry of Education's Notice on Regulating the Acceptance of International Students in our Institutions of Higher Learning and other relevant regulations. Be physically and mentally healthy. Be at least 17 years old and not more than 23 years old before enrollment.
